notes.title: Nudel Tag update 1.2
notes.notes:
Nudel Tag 1.2 update is here.

After the release of Nudel Tag on other platforms, the update it brought is also coming to Steam players.

This updates introduces:
- new Game Modes (now playable in Teams or in a One Vs All mode, in addition to classic Nudel Tag free for all)
- new Bonuses (on top of existing Speed & Invincible, now you can get a Whip, Ice Cubes or a huge Dash)
- new Maps (for a total of 14 maps)
- Better UI & UX
- improved panda speed & controls

Have fun !

notes.title: Nudel Tag update 1.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.1 is now live !


This is the biggest update so far. 

You will find, in Nudel Tag :
- improved panda gameplay (a dash, a dodge, on top of regular hitting on each others)
- 10 maps (2 new maps and rework of 4 existing maps)
- a playable Tutorial, to welcome new players to the game
- a new lobby before quick-games & championships
- new UI, with input prompts (for Xbox gamepads only, for now)
- bug-fixing for issues

Have fun !
